// Copied into the immutable released schema-8 checkout only for CI acceptance.
package update

import (
 "context"
 "crypto/sha256"
 "encoding/hex"
 "testing"
)

func TestReleasedSchemaEightRejectsSchemaNine(t *testing.T) {
 payload := []byte("schema9 candidate")
 sum := sha256.Sum256(payload)
 m, _ := testManager(t, "v9.0.0", "sha256:"+hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), payload, 9, 8)
 defer m.Close()
 err := m.Check(context.Background())
 status := m.Status()
 if err == nil && status.Compatible { t.Fatal("released schema-8 app unexpectedly accepted schema9", status) }
 if status.CanInstall { t.Fatal("released app exposed install for unsupported schema9") }
}
